cards.english: I am touched by the music.
We are surprised by the answer.
We really enjoyed ourselves on vacation.
It turns out to be true.
She would like to travel more.
I hope we see each other soon.

cards.target: Det verkas som att det stämmer.
Jag minns att vi träffades där.
Jag skulle inte ha gjort det.
Jag skulle vilja ha en glass.
cards.english: I would like an ice cream.

cards.target: I gengäld hjälper jag dig imorgon.
cards.english: In return, I'll help you tomorrow.

cards.target: För det första behöver vi planera.
cards.english: First of all, we need to plan.

cards.target: Jag hoppas innerligt sedan länge verkligen.
cards.english: I sincerely hope for a long time really.

cards.target: De kramas alltid när de ses.
cards.english: They always hug when they see each other.

cards.target: Hon ska börja ett nytt jobb.
cards.english: She is going to start a new job.

cards.target: Vi skulle vilja bo vid havet.
cards.english: We would like to live by the sea.

cards.target: Vädret kommer att förbättras under veckan snart.
cards.english: The weather will improve in the coming week.

cards.target: Med det sagt vill jag tacka er.
cards.english: With that said, I want to thank you.

cards.target: Jag ska handla på vägen hem också.
cards.english: I'm going to shop on the way home too.

cards.target: Vi ska fira med hela familjen också.
cards.english: We're going to celebrate with the whole family too.

cards.target: Han ville veta hur länge vi stannade.
cards.english: He wanted to know how long we were staying.

cards.target: Antingen åker vi idag eller imorgon under sommaren.
cards.english: Either we go today or tomorrow during the summer.

cards.target: Hon ville veta vilken film vi hade sett.
cards.english: She wanted to know which movie we had seen.

cards.target: Vi giftes i juni sedan länge på jobbet.
cards.english: We got married in June and had worked there a long time.

cards.target: Vi ska åka på semester till Spanien nästa månad.
cards.english: We are going on vacation to Spain next month.

cards.target: Barnen som lekte på skolgården såg väldigt glada ut.
cards.english: The children playing in the schoolyard looked very happy.
We hugged for a long time.
We are amused by the entertainment.
He is confused by the instructions.
We are motivated by the results.
We'll meet at half past four.
